items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: So -- and then, as the years go by, then I visit with him every time I get a chance, to catch up.

ctx.x: So -- and then, as the years go by, then I visit with him every time I get a chance, to catch up. Then the Joe Williams incident, Joe Williams was with me, I was managing him at that particular time. And then he left me and went with the Count Small group.
Yeah, the Count Small group was playing down on Randolph.
